examples.everyday: Taking the train is an alternative.

check.explanation: Alternative: A different possible choice. Example: We need an alternative plan.
check.hint: Think about how "alternative" is used in this example: We need an alternative plan.

explanation.en: An alternative gives people another way to reach the same goal.
explanation.taglish: Ang alternative ay ibang paraan o choice kapag hindi bagay ang unang plano.

examples.work: Another option would be to use our existing equipment.
examples.everyday: Another option would be to cook at home.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.text: Buying new equipment would be expensive.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Another option would be to use our existing equipment.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.text: That could work. Let's check what we already have.

check.prompt: Complete: 'Another option would be to ___ the plan.'
check.explanation: Use the base verb after 'to' in this pattern: Another option would be to simplify the plan.
check.hint: Read the complete example aloud: Another option would be to use our existing equipment.

grammarTip.explanation: Use 'Another option would be to + base verb': 'Another option would be to use our equipment.' This presents a possible choice, not a confirmed decision.

speaking.scenario: Offer a different way to complete a project when the first plan is too expensive.
hints: Another option would be to use the tools we already have.
Ask a follow-up question or end politely.
speaking.oneMinuteGoal: Introduce your point and support it with one example.
speaking.twoMinuteGoal: Add a second example, a reason, and a friendly closing.
speaking.modelResponse: Another option would be to use our existing equipment instead of buying new machines. That would cost less. We could test it on one part of the project first and check whether it meets our needs.
selfReview: I answered the situation with a clear main message.
I included the detail or question the listener needs.
I chose one sentence to improve or practice again.

durationGuidance.en: One and two minutes are optional practice targets, not minimums. A shorter complete message counts. Start with two or three sentences, then add detail if useful.
durationGuidance.taglish: Optional targets lang ang isa o dalawang minuto. Puwedeng mas maikli basta malinaw ang mensahe. Magsimula sa dalawa o tatlong pangungusap.
durationGuidance.fil: Gabay lamang ang isa o dalawang minuto, hindi kailangang abutin. Sapat ang mas maikling sagot kung malinaw ang mensahe.

speaking.modelResponseNote: This is one short example, not a script to memorize or a timed one-minute answer. Your details and wording may differ.

prompt.fil: Bago magsalita, alalahanin ang isang pahayag mula sa Araw 6. Gamitin kung angkop; hindi kailangan ng dagdag na rekording.
